evidence.locator: Zhong et al.; MouseLand/zhong-et-al-2025 ba64ac697f5d9914926baac79399e80707a5f3a6; Figshare v2 source audit
evidence.supports: Cortex-wide calcium during reward-free/rewarded exposure, source wall-to-stimulus mapping and frame-aligned behavior; figure coding-direction analysis differs from prospective decoder.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: Existing generated construction controls retain their original engineering scope. No authentic-data model result for this task was established by this inspection; the historical EEG077/sleep007 programme pilot is a separate scope.
excluded_claims: Native/source decoder reproduction, causal learning effects, independent source cohort or direct/viewer performance.

disposition_reason: A genuine stimulus-probability scorer and source-frame-to-position-packet construction path exist on safe decoded arrays. Original NPY intake/export identity, native cohort/phase completeness, units and anatomical pooling validity remain unverified; participant-facing direct/viewer delivery and protected runs are absent.

scientific_target.question: Can a decoder trained only on prereward animals and phases identify the predeclared visual stimulus classes from calcium-derived regional activity in held-out animals after reward-free or rewarded exposure, beyond movement and position?
scientific_target.known_answer: Canonical visual stimulus category0–6 mapped explicitly from source UniqWalls/stim_id and held privately for each complete trial/position packet; the plan freezes a subset before outcomes.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Recorded experimental WallID and the source one-to-one wall/category mapping, not reward delivery, behavioral choice or a label inferred from filename.
scientific_target.case_unit: One fixed-position bin inside a complete eligible moving-corridor trial; trial bins and sessions are nested within animal and phase.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Source mname mouse identity; every datexp/blk remains grouped and repeated phases are dependent.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Cross-animal stimulus decoding after declared regional-mean calibration. It is not individual-cell transfer, author coding-direction reproduction or a causal estimate of unsupervised learning.
exclusions: No assumption that source spks are electrode spikes.
No unsupervised-versus-supervised causal effect from cross-phase score differences alone.
No independent second cohort relative to PAPER-FIND-REP-007.

inputs: Public item_id plus four calcium regional means (V1 area8; mHV0/1/2/9; lHV5/6; aHV3/4), and matched mean movement/normalized position context.

Source decoded spks and behavior are prepared operator-side; trial-local moving-corridor frames are averaged into every frozen normalized-position bin without extrapolation or neighboring-trial borrowing.
Labels from training animals/phases only; training mouse/class weights equalized.
forbidden_inputs: Query WallID, stim_id, phase, animal/date/block, reward/licking, target labels or target-bearing source filenames.
Query-fitted normalization, feature selection or interpolation across trial boundaries.
observation_contract.case_identity: Implemented opaque item_id is SHA256 of session_id, original trial_id and bin index; complete plan enumerates session/mname/datexp/blk. No authentic selected cohort or final ID roster has been prepared.
observation_contract.split: Plan requires train/evaluation animals and phase labels disjoint, with operator-verified prereward training semantics. Whole trials must cover every position bin and every retained mouse/phase must support every frozen class.
observation_contract.coverage: Completeness is relative to supplied frozen manifest; exact native animal/session inventory and safe-export equality remain unverified. Class/position subsets are declared construction choices, not extra benchmarks.

primary.name: Mouse-macro stimulus log loss by exposure phase
primary.aggregation: Packet log loss averaged within mouse/phase then equal mice; no scalar averaging across unlike phases. Equal bins per complete trial retain equal trial weight.
primary.rationale: Proper probability scoring against recorded stimulus identity captures calibrated decoding; source figure reproduction is irrelevant to correctness.

secondary: Mouse-macro class-balanced accuracy by phase; class-support counts and constant/zero-probability diagnostics.
Paired neural-minus-movement/position log loss and accuracy, with same expected IDs/labels/class ordering.

comparators.name: Frozen diagonal-Gaussian neural classifier
comparators.inputs: Four regional means and training targets only.
comparators.procedure: Implemented train-only scaling, uniform class priors, mouse/class-balanced centroids and within-class diagonal variance floor0.1.

comparators.name: Matched movement-position classifier
comparators.inputs: Only mean framewise movement and mean normalized position.
comparators.procedure: Identical diagonal-Gaussian fitting and probability output; isolates observed behavioral-context shortcuts.

comparators.name: Uniform probabilities
comparators.procedure: Prospective explicit chance/calibration reference; constant output remains valid and is flagged.

nuisance_controls: Never equate raw WallID values with canonical category numbers; preserve string/integer wall identity mapping.
Require within-trial ft_Pos/Corridor_Length units and four-region anatomical support; regional pooling is a declared cross-animal calibration, not cell registration.
Record every trial exclusion and behavior-tail truncation; freeze eligibility and class support before outcomes.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired2000 seeded mouse-cluster bootstrap within phase; apply identical resamples to both arms. One mouse is descriptive without population interval. Sessions/bins are not independent animals.
evaluation.failure_policy: Reject missing/duplicate/extra IDs, class-shape mismatch, nonfinite or invalid simplex outputs; true-class log probabilities clip at1e-15 with zero counts reported. Reject incomplete class support and malformed alignment rather than shrinking class set.

implementation.scorer_target: evaluator.score grades actual held stimulus labels with strict probabilities and phase/mouse aggregation; construct_session creates opaque trial-position inputs and Reference implements a train-only numerical comparator.
implementation.delivered_scope: Safe-array operator preparation, numerical reference, strict scorer and allowlisted query JSON. The CLI emits private reports separately but is not an OS confidentiality boundary.
missing: Authenticate original pickled-NPY to safe-NPZ export, source cohort/phase mapping and position units.
Freeze complete native population and protected participant transport; demonstrate anatomical calibration and reference competence.
implementation.execution_evidence: Generated engineering controls for source mapping, leakage, coverage and numerical scoring are documented; no authentic native benchmark/model result established by this revision.

direct_observation.representation: Compact four-value neural plus two-value context records are suitable for a prospective no-tools probability condition; no fixed contexts/demos/collector exist.
direct_observation.boundary: Only allowlisted numeric query and declared training demonstrations, no source labels/identities.
missing: Frozen direct prompts, demonstrations and full response collection.

typed_viewer.representation: A rendering of the same regional values could support visual interpretation, but no typed viewer exists.
typed_viewer.boundary: Render only permitted regional/context observations; do not imply raw-cell spatial or temporal structure absent from packet.
missing: Renderer and a defensible matched-observation visual condition.

tool_assisted.representation: Numerical construction/reference APIs exist, but no bounded per-case investigator transport is supplied.
tool_assisted.boundary: Same training/query observations and model-tool exposure as comparator; no report/label access.
missing: Tool transport, per-case reset and matched budget enforcement.

frozen_program.representation: Operator-only numerical source is present: Frozen train-only numerical classifier and complete probability scorer on normalized source arrays. This does not deliver a participant-facing frozen program mode.
frozen_program.boundary: Training only before reward/evaluation access; no query fitted normalization or label feedback.
missing: Authentic full inputs, participant programme runner and protected execution.

summary: Bind task truth to recorded stimulus mapping and actual four-regional-value query, separating wall codes from canonical categories.
Declare prospective regional calibration and animal/phase-disjoint fitting instead of implying tracked-cell or author-decoder transfer.
Expose actual safe-array/source-intake and participant-access gaps while retaining genuine measured-label scoring.
Keep operator analysis/reference APIs separate from participant-facing access: no delivered mode without its actual participant interface.
revision.source_review: Reviewed complete implementation protocol, construct_session, Reference, query, score and compare code; reused pinned primary source audit.
